links.comparator_used: standard ChatGPT-4o without retrieval-augmented 'deep research' mode
links.outcome: accuracy, comprehensiveness, clarity, and readability of hip arthroscopy patient-education responses
links.effect: Accuracy: 4.7 ± 0.4 vs. 4.0 ± 0.5; p = 0.012. Comprehensiveness: 4.8 ± 0.3 vs. 3.9 ± 0.6; p < 0.001. Clarity: 4.4 ± 0.5 vs. 4.6 ± 0.4; p = 0.048. Readability Likert scores were comparable (p = 0.729), but FKGL and FRES favoured the standard model (both p < 0.001).
links.tradeoff: Reduced clarity and objective readability versus the standard model; FKGL and FRES favoured the standard model (both p < 0.001).
links.quote: Deep research provides superior scientific rigour, whereas the standard model offers better readability.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (deep research mode) added to existing LLM
